name: Cutpurse
text: On Recruit: steal 1 resource from the rival with the most resources. Round Start: steal 1 resource from the rival with the most resources.

name: Grifter
text: On Recruit: steal 1 resource per 2 members you have.

name: Desperado
text: While you have the fewest followers (ties count), double what you steal from spaces, before other bonuses.

name: Robin Hood
text: Whenever you steal from the player with the most followers, +1 follower.

name: Extortionist
text: Whenever a rival buys 5 or more followers, steal 2 resources from that rival.

name: Double Agent
text: On Recruit: swap it for a rival’s member you choose.

name: Fixer
text: Once per game: spend magenta equal to a rival’s member’s cost to steal it.

name: Kingpin
text: Game end: +1 follower per magenta member you have.

name: Snitch
text: Whenever a rival steals from you, they lose 1 follower.
